definitions.P_EH: full-plane integral 0.5 Re(Ex conj(Hy)-Ey conj(Hx)) dxdy; direct raw field quantity, +z net flux
definitions.P_EH_norm: P_EH divided by frozen incident_reference in state normalization; dimensionless diagnostic bridge, not a replacement truth
definitions.P_CPW_ORDER: sum TE/TM abs(Re(power_z_per_abs_e2))*abs(C_PW_norm)^2 for canonical propagating +z order
definitions.P_GRATING_ORDER: saved power_fraction_of_source from frozen launcher grating truth
definitions.SUM_P_GRATING_PROP: sum saved grating order fractions; dimensionless source normalized
definitions.T_MONITOR: saved T_FDTD from launcher field-amplitude convention
definitions.R_MONITOR: saved R_FDTD from launcher field-amplitude convention
definitions.normalization: C_PW incident +z (0,0) TM at IN_REF; EH_norm uses same saved incident_reference; grating uses source normalization
definitions.sign: EH S_z is +z net; C_PW POSTNP is directed +z; R is separate reflected source-normalized scalar
definitions.area: raw x,y are meters; actual-coordinate trapezoid weights; area=5.046e-13 m2

reference_plane.interpretation: reference/sample modal power ratio equals abs(exp(i*kz*dz))^2; propagating lossless modes are invariant, complex kz can change amplitude physically
